info.name: Syntage Accounts Payable Insight Extractions API

params.name: taxpayer.id
params.description: Filter by RFC (Registro Federal de Contribuyentes, exact match)

params.name: extractor
params.description: Filter by extractor (partial match)

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by status (exact match)

params.name: startedAt[before]
params.description: Filter by start date (less than or equal `<=`)

params.name: startedAt[strictly_before]
params.description: Filter by start date (less than `<`)

params.name: startedAt[after]
params.description: Filter by start date (greater than or equal `>=`)

params.name: startedAt[strictly_after]
params.description: Filter by start date (greater than `>`)

params.name: finishedAt[before]
params.description: Filter by finished date (less than or equal `<=`)

params.name: finishedAt[strictly_before]
params.description: Filter by finished date (less than `<`)

params.name: finishedAt[after]
params.description: Filter by finished date (greater than or equal `>=`)

params.name: finishedAt[strictly_after]
params.description: Filter by finished date (greater than `>`)

params.name: exists[rateLimitedAt]
params.description: Filter extractions that was rate limited by SAT

params.name: createdAt[before]
params.description: Filter by resource creation date (less than or equal `<=`)

params.name: createdAt[strictly_before]
params.description: Filter by resource creation date (less than `<`)

params.name: createdAt[after]
params.description: Filter by resource creation date (greater than or equal `>=`)

params.name: createdAt[strictly_after]
params.description: Filter by resource creation date (greater than `>`)

params.name: order[startedAt]
params.description: Order by start date

params.name: order[finishedAt]
params.description: Order by finished date

params.name: order[createdAt]
params.description: Order by resource creation date

params.name: order[updatedAt]
params.description: Order by resource update date

params.name: id[lt]
params.description: Collection cursor pointer to the next page

params.name: id[gt]
params.description: Collection cursor pointer to the previous page

params.name: itemsPerPage
params.description: Number of items per page

items.docs: List extraction tasks and filter them by entity, extractor, status, dates, or SAT rate limit state.

Create an extraction for a specific entity, extractor, and options.

If an equivalent extraction is already `pending` or `running` for the same entity, extractor, and options, the API returns `409 Conflict` instead of starting a duplicate. Retrieve the in-progress extraction to track its status rather than retrying the request.
Retrieve a single extraction, including its extractor, options, status, timing, error code, and data point counts.

info.name: Request the extraction to be stopped

items.docs: Request cancellation for a pending or running extraction.
